assetCoverage.arrangement: 20 kinds with five instances each: idle, walk, attack, cast for compatible casters (attack otherwise), and retained attack direction with idle/walk. Owner alternates by instance group, so every kind appears on both teams.

cycles.scope: Controlled mixed 20-kind / 100-visible-unit presentation fixture, no simulation or combat execution. Full authored density 4 and original tile/mip/lighting/shadow paths. WorldPresentation production actor WebGL + ground Canvas + overlay Canvas. CPU samples disable renderer.render only; real Canvas submission and other resource work remain. Snapshot construction, simulation, capture, GC are excluded. Canvas deferred work and GPU completion are separately represented by real complete-wall samples; complete wall includes fence polling/event-loop scheduling, not GPU timer-query duration or hardware FPS.

latencyProfile.scope: Browser tracing and User Timing are active. World draw measures retain exact performance timestamps; getImageData/copy and selected actual WebGL2 API calls over 1ms emit individual User Timing spans. GL wrappers run only within an active diagnostic WorldLayer row on its own existing context, preserve the original arguments/receiver/return/error and add no GL query, framebuffer check, readback, fence, flush, upload or rendering. Each row retains every selected API call count/inclusive wall/max/error count; glLongCalls retains scalar arguments and enclosing public renderer operation for calls over 1ms. API boundary synchronous wall may include driver validation, queued work, command-channel waits, GC or scheduling: it is not exclusive execution time of the named GPU algorithm. Native GL API timers are nested inside the retained public copy/init/render and world/batch timers; do not add them. The public copy sourceVersion is a supplied texture property, not queried GPU initialization state. All trace hooks add observer overhead. Diagnostic inclusive synchronous wrappers, not formal timing. performance.now/aggregation/scope metadata/row bookkeeping add observation overhead. World layer excludes Canvas passes and true GPU completion; renderer calls include submission/backpressure, not pure GPU duration. The unchanged fixture requests renderer.render no-op during CPU warmup/samples; per-row rendererRenderHookActive records actual wrapper equality. No extra stats() calls, card traversal, GL calls, paints, uploads or rendering are introduced. Snapshot serialization/SHA happens only after each cycle, outside timed draws.
latencyProfile.snapshotHashDefinition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(original snapshot), calculated after cycle; rows reference snapshot index, not a rewritten/render-mutated fixture. Raw final visible facts remain in harness pixelProof.
